prompt: Use case: production enemy body candidate for a 2D Unity survivor game. ENEMY-006, Royal Guard Crossbowman. ONE isolated full-body human soldier sprite on a genuinely transparent square canvas, no ground shadow. Stylized hand-drawn storybook cutout consistent with a blue-and-gold royal archer and armored guard captain: thick irregular dark charcoal-plum outline, chunky readable 3–5 shape silhouette, matte muted royal blue, cream linen and warm steel, simple cel shade, minimal fine detail. Three-quarter top-down orthographic gameplay view, facing RIGHT and slightly toward viewer, composed neutral animation-ready stance with both boots on same horizontal ground-contact line. Trained focused pursuer, upright human proportions, blue short guard tabard and simple helmet. Hold a compact visibly mechanical CROSSBOW across the torso, stock and bow limbs kept close to body, clearly distinct from a longbow or firearm. The crossbow must remain readable when reduced to a 256px enemy sprite. Body approximately 70–78% canvas height with generous alpha margin, compact enough for one circular contact profile. No bolts in flight, no baked attack flash or trails, no text, frame, scenery, pixel art, pseudo-3D rendering, green skin or goblin features.
